additional_user_requirements: Show actual local virtual environments and which are actively selected, activated, or in use; do not confuse them with .env files.

Track .env path/scope/owner, variable names/schema and presence, required/optional state, consumers, change metadata, missing/duplicate/conflicting variables, ignore/exposure status, and secret-provider relationships without retaining values.

Do not use plain SHA-256 as a disclosure defense for low-entropy secrets; omit value fingerprints by default and allow keyed HMAC only with an approved secret source and justified change-detection need.

Track system tools by executable/path, version, install source, capabilities, project requirements, dependencies, environment requirements, health, last verification, update availability, conflicts, and trust/admission state.
Make tool, virtual-environment, and .env maintenance/deletion exact-target, impact-aware, confirm-gated, reversible where possible, and receipted.
